title: Ore Choir
summary: Start: enter the system. The log opens Ore Choir and the helm marks Choir Anvil. Do: Close on Choir Anvil. A claim jumper sits the rim pocket and chases a keel that enters it. A kite holds the belt flank. The Choir Hauler orbits the anvil. Finish: come inside Choir Anvil's shell. The Charter writes standing. The belt is a lease, not a gift. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close.
